Frequently Asked Questions
Please reach us at dispatch@bartoncountymo911.gov if you cannot find an answer to your question.
How do you apply for a dispatcher position? Apply in person at 1010 Cherry St in Lamar. You can find more info on open positions on our Facebook page.
What are the roles of a dispatcher? Police, fire, and ambulance dispatchers answer emergency and nonemergency calls. They quickly determine the type of emergency, its location and the response needed, then relay that information to the appropriate emergency responders.
Do you need any experience to become a dispatcher? No previous experience is needed but is a plus. Must have the ability to multitask. Have basic knowledge of computers and be able to work in a fast paced environment.
How do I become a storm spotter? If you are interested in becoming a spotter please contact us via email at emergencymanager@bartoncountymo911.gov
When do they test the storm sirens? The Outdoor Warning Siren System is tested monthly on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 10am.
How do I submit storm damage photos? You can send us photos to emergencymanager@bartoncountymo911.gov Please make sure they have location, time/date, and view direction info listed.
